timing_scope: Real subprocess launch, JSONL input transfer/parsing, algorithms and output serialization/transfer; excludes parent generator/oracle/validation.
limitations: Local Windows verification; no CPU affinity or memory-container cap was enforced. Times are observations, not worst-case guarantees.

batches.name: lcs_million_cells
batches.expected_justification: Shifted alternating strings lose one endpoint; disjoint alphabets give zero; equal strings give 1000.

batches.name: merge_200_large_and_zero
batches.expected_justification: Equal weights: minimum external path length 56*7 + 144*8 = 1544; ordered balanced splits attain it. Zeros cost zero.

batches.name: tree_100000_chain_star_negative
batches.expected_justification: Even chain permits exactly 50000 vertices; star optimum is all 99999 leaves; negative weights favour the empty set.

batches.name: naive_3000_limits
batches.expected_justification: All-a starts are exactly 0..n-m; empty pattern matches n+1 boundaries.

batches.name: kmp_200000_100000_limits
batches.expected_justification: All-a overlap count n-m+1; absent b rejects long almost-matches; empty pattern emits every boundary.

batches.name: rk_20million_product_and_10000_length
batches.expected_justification: First two products equal 20000000. All-a windows match, longer pattern cannot fit; dj collides with ab but is unequal.

batches.name: suffix_50000_repetitive
batches.expected_justification: All suffixes are a-runs: increasing length gives suffix order; adjacent common prefix lengths are 0..49999.

batches.name: suffix_50000_random_ascii
batches.expected_justification: Seed 4201, uniform printable ASCII 32..126. Independent literal suffix comparator and direct adjacent prefix comparisons.

batches.name: aho_10000_duplicates_dense_200000_text
batches.expected_justification: Exactly 100000 total pattern characters. Each duplicate length-10 pattern has 200000-10+1 overlapping starts.

batches.name: aho_100_text_rows_10000_columns
batches.expected_justification: 100 independent texts total 200000 characters; every row/duplicate column has 2000-10+1 = 1991.

batches.name: aho_100001_states_deep_failure_chain
batches.expected_justification: One 100000-character pattern creates 100001 trie states; overlapping starts total 100001.

batches.name: aho_dense_suffix_patterns_L100000
batches.expected_justification: Pattern lengths 1..446 plus duplicate length 319 sum to 100000. Every pattern is a suffix of longer ones; each count is 200001-length.

batches.name: aho_wide_ascii_trie_100_texts
batches.expected_justification: Seed 4202, 10000 length-10 printable ASCII patterns (L=100000). An all-a text only matches the exact pattern a^10.
